kpis.name: Biologics Sales Growth (Constant Currency)
kpis.explanation: Biologics segment sales growth, excluding currency effects.
kpis.description: The Biologics segment continues to grow thanks to strong demand for advanced therapies and strategic partnerships with biotech and Big Pharma companies.

kpis.name: Small Molecules Sales Growth (Constant Currency)
kpis.explanation: Small Molecules segment sales growth, excluding currency effects.
kpis.description: The Small Molecules segment shows limited growth, reflecting a mature market with stable but low-momentum demand.

kpis.name: CORE EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin excluding exceptional items and IFRS effects.
kpis.description: CORE EBITDA margin is declining due to integration costs, investments, and diseconomies of scale on certain projects.

kpis.name: Biologics CORE EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin of the Biologics segment.
kpis.description: The Biologics segment maintains elevated margins, reflecting its profitable business model and technological leadership.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (CAPEX)
kpis.explanation: Expenditures on fixed assets to maintain and expand production capacity.
kpis.description: Lonza continues to invest heavily in its biologics production facilities to meet growing demand.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue declined slightly on a reported basis to 3.057 billion CHF, but grew 1.8% in constant currency at 3.103 billion CHF, reflecting negative currency impact.
kpis.signal: Slight decline on reported basis, growth in constant currency

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 5.0 CHF last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.282 billion CHF last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 3 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 45.3% last year.

ai_positioning.summary: Lonza adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, progressively integrating it into its R&D and drug development processes, without making it a core strategic pillar at this time.
evidence: No mention of AI in KPIs or strategic priorities in the half-year report
No references to AI partnerships or tools in the Biologics or Small Molecules segments
Focus remaining on operational execution and integration of existing capacity
